benchmark_scope: LiU-ICE current protocol and separate Marine Engine Fault metadata/audit track

source_basis.survey_title: Towards Deployable Anomaly Detection in industrial CPS/ICS: A Survey and Deployability Assessment
source_basis.survey_finding: Detection accuracy was consistently reported; evidence for the other deployability criteria was often limited or absent.

non_compensatory_rule: No weighted average can turn a missing safety, security, timing, assurance, resource or privacy dimension into a pass. A dimension is qualified only on its own predeclared evidence and independent review. Aggregate readiness scores are prohibited.

dimensions.label: Detection accuracy
dimensions.definition: Distinguish fault-free and faulty observations and rank the correct known/unknown diagnosis.
dimensions.protocol: Use exact official sample-level scorer, source-bound labels, identical channel availability and frozen splits. Report per-fault, magnitude and cycle strata.
qualification_gates: official score reproduced from labels and predictions
same frozen recordings for every comparator
unknown/abstention performance reported with known-class recall
independent recording-level uncertainty
dimensions.research_target: Improve the best faithful matched published baseline by at least +0.05 absolute official score with FAR no worse; aspiration only.

dimensions.label: Operational resilience
dimensions.definition: Remain predictable under missing, stale, noisy, delayed, conflicted, degraded or unavailable measurements and model-side failures.
dimensions.protocol: Inject one fault at a time and common-cause groups into signals and model/stream state. Do not impute missing channels; count only observed time as exposure; poison stateful sessions after uncertain transitions.
qualification_gates: missing/stale/conflicted data never become normal by default
gaps do not inflate healthy exposure
invalid model output causes fail-closed recovery
grouped dependency outages tested independently
dimensions.research_target: No silent nominal imputation and no increase in diagnostic confidence under missing evidence.

dimensions.label: Adaptability
dimensions.definition: Retain known-fault capability under operating-condition shift while handling previously unseen fault semantics without false-known claims.
dimensions.protocol: Run C-shift, F-shift and C+F as separate whole-recording tracks. Freeze support regions and thresholds before test; after each update re-test all earlier regimes.
qualification_gates: held-out axis absent from fitting/selection/calibration
C+F tested directly, not inferred from C-only and F-only
unsupported regimes abstain or report not_evaluable
independent test recordings per stratum disclosed
dimensions.research_target: At most 2 percentage points worst-supported-cycle macro-recall loss while unknown false-known remains at or below 5%; aspiration only.

dimensions.label: Real-time responsiveness
dimensions.definition: Consume each new sample and emit one diagnosis within the sample deadline without backlog, future-data leakage or retrospective revision.
dimensions.protocol: Replay at 20 Hz and at declared burst rates on reference hardware; measure end-to-end inference plus receipt creation. Verify contiguous input, one output per accepted sample and append-only historical results.
qualification_gates: zero skipped or duplicate sample outputs
zero historical output mutation
p99 latency below declared deadline
bounded memory/queue under sustained replay
dimensions.research_target: P95 end-to-end per-sample latency under 10 ms on declared reference hardware at 20 Hz, with no queue growth; aspiration only.

dimensions.label: Resource efficiency
dimensions.definition: Run within a declared edge-compute, memory, storage and power budget, including evidence receipt overhead.
dimensions.protocol: Benchmark release artifacts on pinned reference hardware with warm/cold starts, long-running replay and peak-load tests. Report both model-only and full evidence/receipt overhead.
qualification_gates: hardware, compiler flags and power measurement method disclosed
peak memory remains within predeclared budget
receipt overhead included
sustained throughput exceeds source rate without backlog
dimensions.research_target: Demonstrate a declared resource budget on one reproducible edge platform; no numeric claim until a reference device is selected.

dimensions.label: Adversarial robustness
dimensions.definition: Detect or safely reject maliciously manipulated telemetry, replayed receipts, poisoned calibration data and unauthorized evidence requests.
dimensions.protocol: Test replay, reordering, tampering, malicious values, stale/future timestamps, calibration contamination and authority revocation. Distinguish integrity digests from authenticated signatures and trusted acquisition.
qualification_gates: receipt digest tampering rejected
source signature and identity checked by upstream trust service
calibration provenance separated from evaluation
replay and revocation tests executed
dimensions.research_target: Zero accepted tampered/replayed receipts and zero unauthorized evidence selections in the frozen adversarial suite; aspiration only.

dimensions.label: Data confidentiality
dimensions.definition: Prevent unauthorized disclosure of engine telemetry, vessel operational state, identities, maintenance records and model artifacts.
dimensions.protocol: Define data minimization, retention, encryption, access roles, tenant boundaries, model/log redaction and deletion procedures before any fleet integration.
qualification_gates: data classification and lawful basis recorded
role/scope enforcement independently tested
sensitive raw data not embedded in public receipts
retention, export and deletion exercised
dimensions.research_target: No unauthorized access or cross-tenant leakage under independent security tests; no production claim until deployed controls exist.

dimensions.label: Explainability
dimensions.definition: Give operators a traceable reason for alarms, uncertainty, rejected candidates and unresolved competing fault hypotheses.
dimensions.protocol: For every alarm expose signal provenance, response residuals, regime support, calibrated thresholds, alternative causes, evidence gaps and why a unique cause was or was not identifiable.
qualification_gates: no unique cause when multiple hypotheses remain admissible
rejected evidence candidates retain reasons
operator review understands ambiguity and limits
every displayed result links to replayable source evidence
dimensions.research_target: Zero false-unique-root-cause claims and at least 90% correct operator interpretation in a preregistered user study; aspiration only.

dimensions.label: Verification and assurance
dimensions.definition: Establish that the exact artifact behaves as intended under unit, contract, adversarial, external replay and independent review.
dimensions.protocol: Bind exact commit, dataset, model, split, evaluator, configuration and receipt digests. Separate source written, locally compiled, CI passed, external reproduced, testbed validated and field evaluated.
qualification_gates: no skipped or pending job treated as pass
independent replay on exact artifacts
failed negative controls fail the run
physical/field claims require independent testbed or field evidence
dimensions.research_target: 100% of qualified claims have an exact-head, independently replayable evidence bundle and reviewer sign-off; aspiration only.

prohibited_inference: A source module, synthetic contract test, green CI job or literature score does not establish physical-engine, vessel, fleet, safety or OEM certification.
